description: This file contains unit tests for the urandom implementation in BoringSSL, specifically testing system call interactions and behavior of the getrandom and urandom system calls using ptrace to simulate various conditions.

classes.name: Event
classes.description: Represents a system call event observed during ptrace tracing, including types like getrandom, open, read, socket, connect, close, and abort.

classes.name: SyscallResult
classes.description: A helper class similar to std::optional<int> to handle syscall return values during tracing.

methods.name: GetTrace
methods.description: Runs a function in a forked process under ptrace, observing system calls and simulating failures based on flags.

methods.name: TestFunction
methods.description: A test function that calls RAND_bytes twice, used as the target for tracing.

methods.name: TestFunctionPRNGModel
methods.description: A model of how urandom.c should behave, used to generate expected trace events for comparison.

methods.name: CheckInvariants
methods.description: Checks certain invariants in the trace, such as no blocking getrandom calls when RDRAND is available in FIPS mode.
